A quote for a customer, tracked from Quoted to Delivered.
An item you offer, with a price and no customer. When someone buys it, just click "Sell".
Photo and deadline appear in the PDF and the message. Contact, model file and link stay with you.

Save to update the order. The original creation date is kept. What you were working on in Quote comes back when you're done.
Save to update the product. The original creation date is kept. What you were working on in Quote comes back when you're done.
Fill in the customer and deadline, then save the order. The product stays in the catalog, unchanged.

Weight, time, photo, printer and filament come from the slicer file.
Each file becomes a print. When you drop it, you can pick which print it replaces.
Choose the filament to enter the weight in grams. The conversion uses its density.
Multicolor part: each filament has its own usage and price.
Use the weight or meters the slicer reports for each filament (purge and tower included).
How many times this plate runs in the order: 4 identical plates of keychains is one print × 4.
This is different from the number of parts, which repeats the whole order. Time and usage here are for one run.
The whole order, charged at %1$s/h, without the margin on top.
Total for the %1$d parts, charged at %2$s/h, without the margin on top. Changed the quantity? Review the time.

Not counting machine time: slicing, plate setup, removing the print, removing supports, sanding, painting, packing. The hourly rate can be adjusted in Settings. If finishing is already in the percentage in Settings, don't count it here.
Your labor isn't in the price yet. Enter the time for this order.
The price applies to this order: check the service and enter how much you'll charge for it.
The channel fee comes out of what you receive. The price goes up enough to keep your margin the same.
The fee applies to everything the customer pays, including services and shipping, the way Etsy, eBay, Amazon and card processors really charge. Set up your channels in Settings.
The channel "%1$s" on this quote no longer exists in your list. The saved price still holds. To recalculate, pick another channel or "Direct sale" above.
Its own line in the total, never built into the part price.
Shipping is passed through, not your product: it isn't multiplied by the quantity or counted in the margin. The channel fee and tax apply to it, because the customer pays everything together.
Only for you. It doesn't appear in the PDF or the message.
The total the customer will pay, if different from the calculated one.
Enter the amount the customer offered and see what's left. It becomes the real price of the quote: it goes to the PDF, the history and the Dashboard. Leave it empty to use your margin price.
A round number for the storefront, in place of what the margin gave.
This is the price shown in the catalog, the PDF and the image, and the price the order gets when you click "Sell". Leave it empty to list the calculated price.
Listed product price: %1$s. Shipping and services are added on top. Enter an amount in Agreed price to agree on a different price.
Free shipping for the customer (you pay)
The customer sees "Free shipping" and the cost comes out of your profit.
